text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Two banks, the North Estonian Bank and Union Bank, will merge to form the second largest commercial bank in Estonia.

- The Foreign ministry is looking for a candidate to be posted as ambassador to the USA, Canada and Mexico, as well as for charges d'affaires to work in Portugal, Greece, Spain, Ireland, the Netherlands and the Czech Republic.
- A new nationwide campaign against violence against children has been launched with TV adverts and posters.
- Centre Party leader Edgar Savisaar criticises government policy towards Russia in a newspaper interview and says ruling policians have been alienated from the people.
- The Russian parties in parliament will start negotiations to recreate the Russian faction which fell apart late last year.
- The environment ministry has broken the law by using funds for environmental projects to buy cars and appartments and to grant loans.
- Economic experts warn that last year's negative balance of payments shows a fall in investments in Estonia.
